# 15｜Lesson 15：Secrecy in Industry

> 📌 **《新概念英语四 · 双语精讲》系列 · 第 15 篇 / 共 48 篇**
> 📖 Lesson 15 · 17 句 · 14 词 · 3 个语法点 · 6 道自测题

## 01 课文精读 · Text

**1. Two factors weigh heavily against the effectiveness of scientific research in industry.**

有两个因素严重阻碍了工业中科学研究的有效性。

**2. One is the general atmosphere of secrecy in which it is carried out,**

一个是它所进行的普遍保密氛围，

**3. the other the lack of freedom of the individual research worker.**

另一个是单个研究人员缺乏自由。

**4. In so far as any inquiry is a secret one,**

只要任何一项调查是秘密的，

**5. it naturally limits all those engaged in carrying it out from effective contact with their fellow scientists either in other countries or in universities,**

它自然会限制所有从事这项工作的人与他们在其他国家或大学的同行科学家进行有效接触，

**6. or even, often enough, in other departments of the same firm.**

甚至，在很多情况下，与同一公司的其他部门也无法有效接触。

**7. The degree of secrecy naturally varies considerably.**

保密程度自然差异很大。

**8. Some of the bigger firms are engaged in researches which are of such general and fundamental nature**

一些大公司从事的研究具有普遍性和基础性，

**9. that it is a positive advantage to them not to keep them secret.**

因此不保密对他们来说是一种积极的优势。

**10. Yet a great many processes depending on such research are sought for with complete secrecy until the stage at which patents can be taken out.**

然而，许多依赖此类研究的工艺在专利可以申请之前，都以完全保密的方式进行探索。

**11. Even more processes are never patented at all but kept as secret processes.**

甚至更多的工艺根本不申请专利，而是作为秘密工艺保存。

**12. This applies particularly to chemical industries,**

这尤其适用于化学工业，

**13. where chance discoveries play a much larger part than they do in physical and mechanical industries.**

因为在化学工业中，偶然发现所起的作用远大于在物理和机械工业中。

**14. Sometimes the secrecy goes to such an extent that the whole nature of the research cannot be mentioned.**

有时保密程度如此之高，以至于整个研究的性质都不能被提及。

**15. Many firms, for instance have great difficulty in obtaining technical or scientific books from libraries**

举例来说，许多公司在从图书馆获取技术或科学书籍时面临很大困难，

**16. because they are unwilling to have their names entered as having taken out such and such a book,**

因为他们不愿留下借阅某某书籍的记录，

**17. for fear the agents of other firms should be able to trace the kind of research they are likely to be undertaking.**

唯恐其他公司的代理人能够据此追踪他们可能正在进行的研究类型。

## 03 语法精讲 · Grammar

**1. 定语从句的省略结构**

`句子1, + 名词/代词 + 其他成分（省略与前文重复的主语+be/谓语动词）`

在并列结构中，当第二个分句的主语和谓语与前一分句的主语和be动词相同时，可以省略主语和be动词，仅保留剩余成分

常用于对比、列举两个并列的因素、情况，使句子更简洁凝练，避免重复

**例句：Two factors weigh heavily against the effectiveness of scientific research in industry. One is the general atmosphere of secrecy in which it is carried out, the other the lack of freedom of the individual research worker.**

有两个因素严重地妨碍着工业中科学研究的效率：一是科研工作中普遍存在的保密气氛，二是研究人员缺乏个人自由。

**2. such...that...引导的结果状语从句**

`such + (a/an) + 形容词 + 可数名词单数/不可数名词/可数名词复数 + that 从句`

用于表示“如此…以至于…”，强调程度，引出前文动作或状态带来的结果

当修饰的中心词是名词时用such，若修饰形容词或副词则用so，that引导的从句表示结果

**例句：Some of the bigger firms are engaged in researches which are of such general and fundamental nature that it is a positive advantage to them not to keep them secret.**

某些大公司进行的研究属于一般性和基础性的研究，因此不保密对它们反而更有好处。

**3. 状语从句中的虚拟语气**

`主句 + for fear that / lest / in case + 主语 + should + 动词原形`

在for fear that, in case, lest等引导的目的状语从句中，常用“should + 动词原形”的虚拟语气结构，表示担忧的、可能性较小的情况

用于表达“生怕、以防、唯恐”的含义，should可以省略，尤其在口语和非正式文体中

**例句：Many firms, for instance have great difficulty in obtaining technical or scientific books from libraries because they are unwilling to have their names entered as having taken out such and such a book, for fear the agents of other firms should be able to trace the kind of research they are likely to be undertaking.**

例如，许多公司很难从图书馆借到技术或科学书籍，因为它们不愿意让自己的名字被登记为借了某某类书籍，生怕其他公司的情报人员能够据此推断出他们可能正在进行的研究类型。

## 04 句型模仿 · Patterns

- **Two factors weigh heavily against... One is..., the other...**
  - 课文原句：Two factors weigh heavily against the effectiveness of scientific research in industry. One is the general atmosphere of secrecy in which it is carried out, the other the lack of freedom of the individual research worker.（有两个因素严重地妨碍着工业中科学研究的效率：一是科研工作中普遍存在的保密气氛，二是研究人员缺乏个人自由。）
  - 仿写：Two factors weigh heavily against the popularity of the new product. One is its high price, the other its complex operation.（有两个因素严重影响这款新产品的普及：一是价格过高，二是操作复杂。）
- **This applies particularly to..., where...**
  - 课文原句：This applies particularly to chemical industries, where chance discoveries play a much larger part than they do in physical and mechanical industries.（这种情况在化学工业尤其适用，在该行业中，偶然发现的作用要比在物理和机械工业中大得多。）
  - 仿写：This learning method applies particularly to language learners, where enough input is the key to improvement.（这种学习方法尤其适合语言学习者，对他们来说，足量的输入是提升的关键。）
- **Sometimes the ... goes to such an extent that...**
  - 课文原句：Sometimes the secrecy goes to such an extent that the whole nature of the research cannot be mentioned.（有时保密的程度到了连研究的性质都不能提及的地步。）
  - 仿写：Sometimes the competition in the industry goes to such an extent that companies cut their prices below cost.（有时行业内的竞争激烈到了公司把价格降到成本以下的程度。）

## 06 参考答案 · Answer Key
